name: Multi-Page Meeting Document Visual Question Answering
description: Dataset for multi-page meeting document visual question answering, where models answer natural language questions based on images of meeting documents.
card_text: This dataset evaluates document visual question answering over multi-page meeting documents. Inputs consist of one or more document page images and a natural language question about the document content (e.g., counting barcodes, extracting specific attributes). The expected output is a short free-text answer. The dataset contains 91 samples, with document images provided as file references and questions/answers in text. Models must read and reason over the visual document pages without any pre-extracted text, testing content recognition and question answering capabilities in a business meeting document domain.

context.semantics: A list of image file references representing the pages of a multi-page meeting document. These images form the visual context that the model must read and interpret to answer the question.

question.semantics: A natural language question about the content of the meeting document, such as counting objects or extracting specific factual information.

answer.semantics: A list containing the short free-text answer(s) to the question, derived from the meeting document images.

meta.meta_structure_description: Each sample contains an input object with a textual question (input.prompt) and a list of image files (input.image_files) that serve as the multi-page meeting document context. The output object holds a list of answer strings (output.text). The model must read the document images to answer the question with a short factual response.
